coverage_audit.notes: Source items are counted as distinct evidence locations: every text passage, table cell group, figure callout and dimension label that supports a claim. Text, tables, figure callouts, figure notes and dimension labels were all processed for all 15 pages. Page images could not be rasterised for an independent visual pass in this run, so visual_content_checked is false and coverage_complete is false: width/depth axis assignments on Figures 3-3, 3-4 and 3-5 and the role of two dimensions in Figures 3-3 and 3-8a follow label-position convention and are flagged individually. No number was read off by drawing scale. Chapter completeness is evidenced by the chapter opening on the first input page and the reference list on the last.

top_findings.why_useful: Layered perimeter clearances around a dining table (seat, chair movement, through traffic) are the most directly usable operational knowledge in the chapter.
Sofa-to-table clearance with an explicit conditional minimum, one of the few genuinely hard candidates.
Per-person occupancy envelope for upholstered seating, needed before any cluster geometry can be validated.
Conversation cluster diameter, the geometric core of the chapter's seating logic.
IRC ceiling height and beam clearance minimums, hard constraints independent of furniture.
